name: session-meter
description: Gauges above the prompt: prompt-cache age on a green-to-red dial with a needle, context window fill as a ring with the tokens inside, and the session's cost in euro or dollars.

warnMinutes.title: Cache age turning yellow (minutes)
warnMinutes.description: From this cache age on, the cache dial and its figure are yellow.

staleMinutes.title: Cache age turning red (minutes)
staleMinutes.description: Past this cache age, the cache dial and its figure are red.

gaugeMinutes.title: Cache gauge full scale (minutes)
gaugeMinutes.description: The cache age at the dial's right end; the needle stops there.

currency.title: Cost currency
currency.description: EUR converts the session cost at the ECB daily reference rate; USD shows the engine's figure as is.

rateUrl.title: Exchange-rate feed
rateUrl.description: ECB daily reference rates (XML), read for the USD rate per euro.

rateRefreshHours.title: Exchange-rate refresh (hours)
rateRefreshHours.description: A stored rate older than this is fetched again.
